    DatabaseManager
    Utility class providing static methods for all database operations used by the POS application.
    DatabaseManager.InventoryItem
    Represents a single row in the inventory table.
    DatabaseManager.InventoryUsageItem
    Holds an inventory ingredient's name and the total units consumed in a date range, used for the Inventory Usage report.
    DatabaseManager.OrderLineInput
    Encapsulates all information needed for a single line of an order: the product, quantity, size, sugar level, and topping selections.
    DatabaseManager.PaymentInput
    Encapsulates all payment details for an order transaction, including type, amounts, and change.
    DatabaseManager.ProductItem
    Represents a single product row returned from the products table.
    DatabaseManager.ProductUsageItem
    Holds a product's name and its total order count, used for the Most Ordered Items report.
    DatabaseManager.SubmitOrderResult
    Holds the result of a successful order submission, including the payment record ID and the range of order IDs created.
    DatabaseManager.XReportItem
    Holds the sales totals for a single hour of the day, used in the X-report.
    DatabaseManager.ZReportResult
    Holds all financial totals from an end-of-day Z-report, including sales, taxes, voids, payment breakdowns, and the manager's signature.
